result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make suffering harder to ignore.

Not just harder for people to feel pain, but harder to benefit from it. If cruelty, exploitation, and harm became structurally harder to hide—less profitable, less respectable, less socially invisible—then the world would change in a way that didn’t need a grand prophecy or a revolution. It would just gradually become less willing to turn people into tools.
